WenQuanYi Bitmap Song — 12px subset, embedded in Darklands+
==============================================================

Source font : WenQuanYi Bitmap Song 12px
              (WenQuanYi-Bitmap-Song-TTF.Batch / "WenQuanYi Bitmap Song 12px.ttf")
Version     : 0.8 (FirstEmperor), Release 6
Copyright   : (c) 2004-2007, The WenQuanYi Project Board of Trustees and Qianqian Fang
Homepage    : http://wqy.sourceforge.net/en/
Upstream    : https://github.com/brahyerr/wqy-bitmap  (redistribution)
License     : GPL v2.0 with font embedding exception
              (full text below)

What was changed for Darklands+
-------------------------------
The full font was subsetted to only the characters Darklands+ actually renders:
  * every Han character (U+4E00..U+9FFF) used by the game's Chinese text
  * Basic Latin (U+0020..U+007E), Latin-1 Supplement upper half (U+00A0..U+00FF)
  * CJK punctuation U+3000..U+303F, fullwidth U+FF00..U+FFEF, and a few
    symbols used by the port's own UI
The subset is stored in port/third_party/fonts/wqy-12px-cjk.ttf (707 KB) and is
compiled into darklands.exe as a C array (FONT_CJK[] / FONT_CJK_SIZE).

The font is rendered through ImGui's font atlas at 34 px with OversampleH = 1
to preserve the crisp bitmap-pixel look of the original 12x12 grid.

Note: the subset does NOT contain the lowercase Latin accented letters
(U+00E0..U+00FF minus the upper half); those are borrowed at run time from the
system's own CJK font via ImGui's MergeMode fallback, so no Microsoft-owned
font data is redistributed.

Upstream release notes (reproduced from the WenQuanYi Bitmap README):

    Developer: The WenQuanYi Project Contributors
    Font Name: WenQuanYi Bitmap Song
    Version : 0.8 (FirstEmperor)
    Release : 6
    Copyright: (c) 2004-2007, The WenQuanYi Project Board of Trustees
               and Qianqian Fang
    License : GPL v2.0 (with font embedding exception)

    The Wen Quan Yi bitmap font includes complete CJK Unified
    Ideograph (U4E00 - U9FA5) glyphs at four different sizes
    (9pt-12X12 pixel, 10pt-13X13 pixel, 11pt-15X15 pixel,
    12pt-16x16 pixel) and two weights (medium and bold). ... The
    12pt bitmap glyphs between U4E00-U9FA5 were derived from the
    Chinese national standard GB19966-2005.
